about: Hand-kept notes of the new-builds survey (2026-09-28, user request): which new Forever spells could anchor a new build or a hybrid, the raid targets searched for them in the community simulator (a rotation-only entry of raidsim/specs.json each; talents by raidsim/talent_opt.py, the rotation by raidsim/apl_opt.py) and a sentence on each. Numbers are never written here: render_new_builds.py reads them from the races and the fight lab.

notes.Primal Bite: Forever's Mangle, a Feral talent. Bear and Dire Bear only (the client's shapeshift mask, which the simulator follows), so no Cat build can use it; the simulator's Bear rotation casts it.
notes.Berserk: Feral capstone (3 min): Primal Bite hits up to 3 targets without a cooldown, and combo-point builders get +100% crit for 15 s; the Cat drafts take it for the crit.
notes.Lacerate: Bear bleed; the simulator's Bear rotation casts it.
notes.Wild Growth: A party heal (the healer lab's druid heals with it).

targets.idea: Summon Hawk, a Forever Beast Mastery talent that sends a hawk to dive-bomb the target every 6 seconds (two hawks attack at once), in a raid build: searched from the simulator's Beast Mastery preset and from our Marksmanship draft
A melee hunter around the new Survival abilities (Strider Kick, Lacerate) and Aspect of the Beast

notes.Aspect of the Beast: Melee attack power, and melee haste with Deadly Aspects: the fork models only Aspect of the Hawk; our patch (2026-09-29, raidsim/patches/forever/sim/hunter/aspect_of_the_beast.go) adds it and the melee half of Deadly Aspects, so the melee hunter plays with it (our model).
notes.Sniper Shot: A new Marksmanship shot (15 s cooldown); the rotation search offers it.
notes.Pet family abilities: Swipe, Pinch, Dismember, Tendon Rip, Mine!, Savage Rend, Web, Dust Cloud, Thunderstomp, Trickster's Dance: taught to pets; the simulator's pets use Claw, Bite and their family's classic ability.

targets.idea: Frostfire Bolt, which counts as Fire and Frost, as the filler of a Fire/Frost hybrid (the build asked for by name)

leveling.what: the Frost leveling build playing Frostfire Bolt instead of Frostbolt from 40, against itself playing Frostbolt

targets.idea: Arcane Blast, a Forever Arcane talent that stacks its own damage and cost, as a build of its own
Arcane Power Frost with Missile Barrage (Forever talent): Frostbolt, and Arcane Missiles on its procs, which the simulator's Frost rotation never cast

notes.Frostfire Bolt: The community simulator ships it as a stub; this project implements it (raidsim/patches/forever/sim/mage/frostfire_bolt.go), so its numbers are our model. The fight lab plays it from level 40 (fightlab/mage.py decide_frostfire).
notes.Ice Lance: Frost talent; the simulator's Frost rotation casts it on Fingers of Frost.

notes.Holy Strike: The new baseline Retribution strike; every paladin rotation of the simulator casts it.
notes.Swift Judgement: Ends Judgement's cooldown (1 min); the rotation search offers it.
notes.Templar's Bulwark: A tank absorb cooldown; the Protection rotation search offers it.

targets.idea: Penance and Smite: a Discipline/Holy damage build from the simulator's Smite preset

notes.Shadow Word: Death: A new Shadow nuke (15 s cooldown); the simulator's Shadow rotation casts it.
notes.Chastise: Humanoids only; a stub in the simulator.
notes.Dark Sacrifice: Health for mana (Undead); a stub in the simulator.
notes.Prayer of Mending: Healing (the healer lab's priest heals with it).

targets.idea: Mutilate and Venom, the Forever Assassination talents, starting from our Mutilate draft: the tuned rotation casts Backstab before Mutilate (Backstab out-damages it with the simulator's daggers), and the talent search dropped Venom, then Mutilate
targets.result: Kept Mutilate (the search told to keep it), the build loses under half a percent: the rotation never casts it.

targets.idea: Subtlety with Hemorrhage from the simulator's Hemorrhage preset

notes.Mutilate: Forever talent: both weapons strike, more damage on poisoned targets.
notes.Venom: Finishing move: +30% poison damage and chance.

targets.idea: The simulator's Elemental/Enhancement hybrid preset (Stormcaller) tuned as a target of its own
targets.result: The talent search from the preset ended on our Elemental draft's talents (29/22/0): the hybrid is the Elemental build.

notes.Lava Burst: A new Elemental nuke (10 s cooldown, more damage with Flame Shock on the target); the simulator's Elemental rotation casts it.
notes.Fire Nova: Now a spell with a 10 s cooldown instead of a totem: area damage around the fire totem.
notes.Rage of the Farseer: Enhancement cooldown: 30% attack speed for 25 s.
notes.Call of the Elements: Drops several totems at once: utility.
notes.Call of the Ancestors: Drops several totems at once: utility.
notes.Call of the Spirits: Drops several totems at once: utility.

targets.idea: Demonic Pact from the simulator's Demonology preset: a raid Demonology build
Incinerate (+25% on an Immolated target) as the filler, with Conflagrate while Immolate burns
targets.result: The rotation search on this build inserted Shadow Bolt ahead of Incinerate in its first round (training dummy and raid): Shadow Bolt out-damages Incinerate even on an Immolated target. The entry keeps the Incinerate rotation, so the numbers are the build as designed.

notes.Wrack: Affliction capstone: a 6 s channel of 36 Shadow a second that makes Corruption and Bane of Agony tick 10% harder. Probed on the Affliction draft with Siphon Life and Wrack in the rotation (2026-09-28): every placement lost DPS against Shadow Bolt, so no build takes it.
notes.Bane of Havoc: Splits 15% of the warlock's damage to a second target: nothing to split on one boss.
notes.Curse of the Elements: Forever's Curse of the Elements; the simulator's warlock rotations cast it.

notes.Spearing Strike: Arms talent attack; the simulator's DPS rotations cast it.
notes.Victory Rush: Baseline at 20 but needs a killing blow, which a boss never gives: a leveling tool (the fight lab's warrior uses it).
